name: Titan's Grave
description: Titan's Grave is a vast forest and dig site on Arcavios growing in the hollow remains of a giant titan, used as a Witherbloom research site.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

summary.text: Titan's Grave is a vast forest and dig site on Arcavios growing in the hollow remains of a giant titan, used as a Witherbloom research site.

bio.text: Witherbloom students come there to uncover flora and fauna.
Lluwen and Tam arrived at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greeted the students.

bio.text: Lluwen realized the titan's bones were hollow and fell through into the dark, where the lumarets live in the tunnels and led her through them.

bio.text: Later a student freed Gorma into Titan's Grave instead of consuming her, and she developed a huge appetite.

citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

status.text: As of April 2026 Titan's Grave is still a Witherbloom site, now with Gorma loose in it and hungry.

citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen and Tam arrive at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greet the students.
timeline.quote: Oracle Jadzi was the one who greeted all of us when we arrived at Jawdocks Landing.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam and Lluwen talk for hours with Jadzi until Fel scolds them for wasting the oracle's time.
timeline.quote: We spent a few hours talking, just the three of us

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen discovers a society of lumarets with a map in Toadstool Copse.
timeline.quote: The creature had friends.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel dismisses Lluwen's discovery of the lumarets as not worth studying and threatens community service.
timeline.quote: They aren't in any of the records because they aren't worth studying,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel quizzes his students on what they hear; Lluwen, stung by yesterday's rebuke, wants to give a right answer.
timeline.quote: I want to give the right answer

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ivarin taunts Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan, and Lluwen retaliates by slashing his chest with a knife.
timeline.quote: He dragged the knife across Ivarin's chest.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel pins Lluwen's coat to a tree with a thorn and orders him to control himself or find another home.
timeline.quote: You will learn to control yourself, or you will learn to find another home,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen realizes the titan's bones are hollow and falls through into the dark.
timeline.quote: Lluwen fell into the dark.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen wakes in the titan's hollow to find six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic and chanting.
timeline.quote: six enormous figures, each with too many limbs undulating in time, sat gathered around a thick snarl of magic—archaics.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The archaics notice Lluwen sketching and stop, and he flees up a vine while their chant grows louder.
timeline.quote: Lluwen didn't need to be told twice.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel hauls Lluwen out and asks if he has anything to impress him; Lluwen is too afraid to tell him what he saw.
timeline.quote: I hope you have something to impress me.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam tells Lluwen that archaics were once oracles and suggests speaking with Jadzi.
timeline.quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen overhears Fel and Jadzi argue over Fel's scheme involving students and an oath he swore.
timeline.quote: No, I swore an oath of devotion, Jadzi.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi tells Fel that Professor Vess is missing and that another incident after Kasmina's could cause a stir.
timeline.quote: No one knows where she is,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides not to tell Fel about the archaics and returns to his room.
timeline.quote: No. He couldn't tell Fel.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen admits to Tam that he did not tell Jadzi about the archaics; Tam hugs him.
timeline.quote: You aren't a coward.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The ground shakes and a massive creature wreathed in star arches looms over the camp, and Tam freezes.
timeline.quote: A massive figure blocked the gold of the moon.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The giant creature stands and walks away, leaving the camp in chaos.
timeline.quote: it walked away.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.
timeline.quote: His eyes burning, Fel asked the two of them if they had seen Oracle Jadzi.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Kirol, Abigale and Sanar reunite at the chaotic Titan's Grave dig site to search for Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Abigale couldn't hear what was going on around her, but she had a pretty good feeling that Kirol was right about that.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches Kirol and joins the group to help find their friends.
timeline.quote: You might have been clever enough to sneak away, but I was clever enough to know how to find you.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Dina tries to calm the students at the camp as Sanar spots a green smoke signal from Lluwen.
timeline.quote: That's Lluwen's signal! It must be!

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Masked figures ambush the group with a wave of concussive magic as they follow the smoke.
timeline.quote: It was the last thing he managed to say before the whole group got hit with a wave of concussive magic.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes bound and finds Chandra Nalaar surrounded by cloaked, mask-wearing figures.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar stood surrounded on all sides by cloaked figures in masks

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra says she must make sure Ajani has not been compromised, and Lluwen reveals the masked figures are Oriq.
timeline.quote: They're the Oriq.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra explains that the Shattered refused to attack the school and shattered their masks, and she took them under her wing.
timeline.quote: None of the people here attacked the school, Ajani. They all refused.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Jace is alive,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani insists Jace is dead and unmade, upsetting Chandra.
timeline.quote: He didn't just die; his essence was unmade .

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra says Jace is manipulating archaics as the giant archaic appears overhead.
timeline.quote: Manipulating archaics!

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani tackles Chandra as she prepares to blast the archaic, and Lluwen spots Jadzi in its palm.
timeline.quote: Ajani bowled her over and took them both to the ground.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra orders the Shattered to keep Ajani's students busy; walls of fire rise and Ajani breaks his bonds.
timeline.quote: The Shattered blazed into action.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Chandra fight, and he pins her in a hold to stop her attacking.
timeline.quote: He slipped one arm under her chin and the other hand behind her head.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls her gathered fire over their heads and burns the giant archaic, which screams in pain.
timeline.quote: And before he could stop her, Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The wounded archaic looks down at Ajani and Chandra and tears the ground asunder.
timeline.quote: Then it brought its hand down and tore the ground asunder.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam wakes beneath the earth after the archaic's attack; Kirol is hurling boughs off trapped students and Sanar and Abigale are helping.
timeline.quote: That bulky frame hurling boughs off the trapped students could only be Kirol.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen tells Tam they are in Titan's Grave, deeper than any records go.
timeline.quote: "In Titan's Grave. Deeper than we have any records of going, if we can trust the Shattered."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam asks Suki to join the group, and the Shattered come over to share what they know.
timeline.quote: "Come join us," said Tam.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Abigale reports at least two dozen ways out of the chamber.
timeline.quote: But there are at least two dozen ways out of here, maybe more.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen volunteers to scout a path out, and Suki insists he take someone with him; Kirol claims the job.
timeline.quote: "It's best if you have someone with you.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen is moved that Kirol would talk to their family for him; Kirol is stung when Lluwen changes the subject.
timeline.quote: "Well, yeah. But I would for you."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen finds the lumarets and believes they will lead the way out.
timeline.quote: "I think I found our way out of here."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Back at camp Tam frets over being left behind while Sanar and Suki build a metronome clock.
timeline.quote: Sanar and Suki were working on a metronome-based clock.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fetching water, Tam sees a man in white in the reflection until Lluwen's shout breaks the moment.
timeline.quote: It was a man in white.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen leads the group through the tunnels behind the lumarets, growing proud.
timeline.quote: The young elf strode proud down the twisting, impossible hallways.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: A strange feeling of dread spreads through the group and tempers flare; Lluwen snaps at Tam and Kirol.
timeline.quote: "You're the one who brought up the tension.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The lumarets flee and the tunnel begins to shake as a daemogoth reveals itself.
timeline.quote: "I thought I'd have longer for you to ripen."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The tunnel turns against the students and roots seize Lluwen, threatening to drag him into the earth while his friends pull him back.
timeline.quote: Vines wrapped around Lluwen's ankles and threatened to pull him into the earth.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Kirol promises not to leave Lluwen behind.
timeline.quote: "I'm not going to leave you behind, Lulu!"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Professor Fel arrives, and the daemogoth greets him by name and asks about a deal.
timeline.quote: "Dellian. Have you returned to make that deal with me?"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel's magic floods the pit with flowers and fungi that grow through the daemogoth and burst its skull, killing it.
timeline.quote: The daemogoth screamed in the moment before glorious life sprang from its head, bursting its skull.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen asks Fel whether he made a deal with the daemogoth, and Fel dismisses it.
timeline.quote: "With that provincial bogeyman? Ridiculous. It has nothing to offer me."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel says he has been trying to find a way to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, from Jadzi.
timeline.quote: You wanted to try and find some way to go back and save the woman you loved."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel says the last he saw of the huge archaic it was carrying Jadzi nearby, and leads the group toward the exit.
timeline.quote: The last we saw of that huge archaic, it was carrying Jadzi not far from here.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen tells Fel he saw archaics gathered around a snarl, and Fel says there are no snarls in Titan's Grave and asks to be taken there.
timeline.quote: "There are no snarls in Titan's Grave. There never have been,"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Elsewhere in the tunnels, Chandra and Ajani argue; she tells Ajani she believes Jace plans to use the huge archaic.
timeline.quote: "I think it's the archaic. The big one."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks Ajani to help her find and kill the huge archaic before Jace can use it, and he agrees to support her.
timeline.quote: "I'll support you, Chandra.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani walk silently through the tunnels below Titan's Grave.
timeline.quote: Two Planeswalkers trudged through the tunnels below Titan's Grave. Neither of them said a word.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra stumbles in a vision and Ajani catches her by the cloak, then pulls back his hand mid-pat.
timeline.quote: Ajani caught her by the hood of her cloak.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani wonders whether Chandra's visions might be Ashiok's work and descends behind her.
timeline.quote: It could be Ashiok planting these images in her head.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: They hear the archaic wail and Jadzi's voice from ahead.
timeline.quote: They heard the archaic before they saw it.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: They find Jadzi healing the wounded archaic in the titan's skull, opposite a snarl-like swirl of energy.
timeline.quote: Jadzi kneeled in its palm, still, working a complex healing spell across its flesh.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra holds back from striking the wounded archaic.
timeline.quote: It would be so easy. So why did she hesitate?

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi, already aware of them, calls out the girl sneaking up on them.
timeline.quote: There's a girl who thinks she can sneak up on us,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi explains that archaics are oracles flung back in time after death, and that this archaic is the last.
timeline.quote: Archaics are oracles, like I am.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi warns that something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself.
timeline.quote: "Something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra insists the culprit is Jace.
